text: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端
purpose: Compare how the four Core Teachers and Project Hand plan the same scripture before any glyph synthesis or final composition.

questions: How does the opening establish gravity without becoming static?
Where should the first release of movement occur?
Do not sacrifice character identity for cursive continuity.
How should the line re-energize after the central name group?
Which character carries expansion or compression?
Test three-character continuity without mandatory physical linking.
Balance 智 and 慧 so their visual density does not stall the line.
How does 的 bridge into 開 rather than behave as an isolated modern-looking glyph?
How does 端 close firmly without freezing the final cadence?

wang-xizhi.teacherIntent: Natural emergence and continuous brush intention.
plan: Open with controlled weight rather than display.
Use spacing, entry/exit direction and scale to carry qi before considering visible linking.
Allow local variation among glyph choices; do not normalize repeated structural behavior into a font.
Let the central name group remain legible while preserving a living line axis.
Close with gathered force rather than a rigid terminal block.
riskChecks: turning Lanting-like variation into a preset

plan: Create controlled lean and pressure contrast early, but require recovery points.
Use compact centers against released long strokes to produce rhythm.
Treat 智慧 as a density challenge: one may gather while the other releases.
Use stroke ending, spacing and pressure changes to transmit momentum without decorative silk connections.
Make the final group regain balance rather than simply slow down.
Keep the eleven characters immediately readable while avoiding equal-size procession.
Establish structural anchors at key semantic points and allow lighter transitions between them.
Use restrained pitch, spacing and rise/fall to generate movement rather than distortion.
Preserve clarity in 耶和華 and let surrounding groups carry more rhythmic variation.
Finish with a stable 端 whose approach remains fluid.

wen-zhengming.teacherIntent: Controlled structure, bone strength and cultivated long-line rhythm.
plan: Make transitions between characters explicit through rise, fall and directional response.
Maintain bone structure while varying density and spacing across the sentence.
Avoid reducing refinement to small neat glyphs.
Use the long phrase as one compositional breath with internal pauses rather than eleven independent units.
Let the closure become mature and collected, not decorative.

project-hand.teacherIntent: Scripture-first running-script grammar built on the four teachers without averaging them.
stableSpineApplication: Every imbalance must have a contextual purpose and recovery path.
Continuity may be invisible: spacing, scale, axis, entry and exit can carry flow.
Choose glyphs by phrase context before isolated beauty.
Keep sacred text highly legible and dignified without becoming regular-script typesetting.
Use controlled variation in scale, lean, density and spacing.
Keep original, adjusted and reconstructed glyph provenance separate.

provisionalPlan.opening: 敬畏 begins gathered and weighty; movement should emerge rather than arrive pre-decorated.
provisionalPlan.nameGroup: 耶和華 receives maximum identity clarity and a calmer local rhythm, functioning as a semantic center rather than a typographic highlight.
provisionalPlan.turn: 是 acts as a hinge; 智慧 may increase density but must be internally differentiated to avoid a dark block.
provisionalPlan.bridge: 的 should be selected or reconstructed for contextual compatibility, serving as a light bridge into 開.
provisionalPlan.closure: 開 releases space; 端 gathers the sentence into a firm but still living stop.

project-hand.teacherConflictPolicy: No voting and no percentage blend. For each phrase, identify the concrete writing problem, consult the most relevant teacher principle, then use the other teachers as counter-checks against drift.

benchmarkChecks: Can the five plans be distinguished without naming the hand?
Does every proposed movement have a reason in the local phrase context?
Can continuity survive when visible ligatures are removed?
Does 耶和華 remain unmistakably readable in every plan?
Does Project Hand solve problems rather than average teacher mannerisms?
Are unresolved characters still explicitly unresolved rather than silently synthesized?

nextGate.name: retrieval-plan binding
nextGate.requirement: Bind each planning decision to actual corpus candidates and source context before permitting any reconstruction.
